review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on engineering role focused primarily on web application firewalls, edge security, application-layer controls, bot mitigation, API protection, and traffic inspection. 3–5 years of experience in network security, application security, edge security, security operations, infrastructure engineering, or a related role.
